title: Egg custards
hook: Milk and eggs. *Yolks or whole eggs* decide it.
cover_text: Milk and eggs, *swap the yolks*, two custards

dishes.name: Crème anglaise
dishes.text: Yolks only, stirred over low heat. They *thicken it* into a pourable sauce.

dishes.name: Flan
dishes.text: *Whole eggs*, twice the weight, baked: the whites set it firm enough to unmold.

sources: https://ruhlman.com/?p=24396 (Ruhlman: standard anglaise 4 parts milk/cream, 1 part yolk, 1 part sugar)
https://www.cuisinedaubery.com/pubaccess/pierrehermesvanillacustardcrem.pdf (Pierre Hermé crème anglaise: 500 g milk+cream, 120 g yolks, 100 g sugar ≈ 4:1)
https://www.npr.org/transcripts/107019060 (Ruhlman: custard is one part egg to two parts liquid)
https://rouxbe.com/recipes/3129-creme-caramel (crème caramel ≈ 515 g milk, 6 eggs ≈ 2:1, 100 g sugar)
